author: The Hated One
description:
FIFA was hacked during live World Cup and it's even worse than you would think. Support my work: https://www.patreon.com/thehatedone 

Imagine watching a game of World Cup. But this time, it goes different. It's the match between Côte d'Ivoire and Ecuador. Côte d'Ivoire team has the ball and advances on Ecuador. It's three vs five. The ball passes to Amad Diallo. And...

Every live broadcast, every TV and every station that streams live World Cup directly from FIFA is suddenly interrupted. With what exactly may differ. Maybe it's just a rickroll. Maybe it's a message from state-sponsored hackers. Maybe...

For some viewers of the match, it may go on like that for a few seconds. For some, it may be whole minutes. But every stream is universally in panic mode.
They each check if the problem is at their end. Did some of their employees make a programming mistake? Did they get hacked?

title: She Hacked FIFA World Cup Live - Then It Got Worse
